description: A React component for uploading and configuring data files (CSV, Excel, Columnar) into a database within the Superset frontend. Handles file selection, metadata extraction, form submission, and dynamic form fields based on file type.

classes.name: UploadDataModal
classes.description: React functional component for uploading data files with configurable options, integrated with Superset backend API.

methods.name: validateUploadFileExtension
methods.description: Validates if the uploaded file has an allowed extension based on the provided list.

methods.name: loadDatabaseOptions
methods.description: Fetches database options with filtering for databases that allow file uploads.

methods.name: loadSchemaOptions
methods.description: Fetches schema options for the selected database.

methods.name: loadFileMetadata
methods.description: Uploads the selected file to retrieve metadata such as columns and sheet names.

methods.name: appendFormData
methods.description: Appends form data fields to a FormData object, excluding certain fields based on type.

methods.name: onFinish
methods.description: Handles form submission, sending the file and configuration to the backend API.
